% Run from the repository root with pdflatex. The original source is unchanged.
\providecommand{\histogramtickoverride}{}
\newcommand{\histogrampoint}[2]{%
  \pgfextractx{\dimen0}{\pgfpointanchor{#1}{#2}}%
  \pgfextracty{\dimen2}{\pgfpointanchor{#1}{#2}}%
  \typeout{HISTOGRAM #1.#2: \the\dimen0,\the\dimen2}%
}
\AddToHook{begindocument}{%
  \pgfplotsset{
    execute at begin axis={\histogramtickoverride},
    every axis x label/.append style={name=histogram-xlabel},
    every axis y label/.append style={name=histogram-ylabel},
    every x tick label/.append style={name=histogram-xtick},
    every y tick label/.append style={name=histogram-ytick}}
  \NewCommandCopy\histogramoriginalclipright\clipright
  \renewcommand\clipright[1][white]{%
    \typeout{HISTOGRAM BEFORE CROP}%
    \histogrampoint{current axis}{south west}%
    \histogrampoint{current axis}{north east}%
    \histogrampoint{current axis}{outer south west}%
    \histogrampoint{current axis}{outer north}%
    \histogrampoint{current axis}{outer east}%
    \histogrampoint{current bounding box}{south west}%
    \histogrampoint{current bounding box}{north east}%
    \histogrampoint{histogram-xlabel}{center}%
    \histogrampoint{histogram-xlabel}{text}%
    \histogrampoint{histogram-ylabel}{center}%
    \histogrampoint{histogram-ylabel}{text}%
    \histogrampoint{histogram-xtick}{center}%
    \histogrampoint{histogram-ytick}{center}%
    \histogrampoint{histogram-ytick}{text}%
    \histogramoriginalclipright[#1]%
    \typeout{HISTOGRAM AFTER CROP}%
    \histogrampoint{current bounding box}{south west}%
    \histogrampoint{current bounding box}{north east}%
  }%
}
\input{test/fixtures/examples/latex-examples/histogram-large-1d-dataset.tex}
